recommendations.title: Buy New York Knicks -7.5
recommendations.matchup: Cleveland Cavaliers at New York Knicks
recommendations.reason: Recommendation: buy New York Knicks -7.5 at home. The no-vig spread market gives them about a 49% chance to cover, and after our home-court and bucket adjustments we land near 53%. Priced at -105, that works out to roughly +4.3% expected value per dollar, so the side clears our minimum-edge filter.
